name: Villeroy & Boch AG
summary: Villeroy & Boch AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of ceramic products under the Villeroy & Boch brand in Germany. It operates through two divisions, Bathroom & Wellness, and Dining & Lifestyle. The company offers ceramic bathroom collections, ceramic kitchen sinks, fittings, bathroom furniture, showers, bathtubs, pipe connectors, installation systems, and matching accessories; and porcelain, glass and cutlery, as well as home accessories and gifts. It also provides tiles, lighting, carpets for indoor and outdoor use; bathroom and kitchen textiles; and blankets and cushions.
